chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.domain_rule: Obstacle and unknown races remain in the denominator but cannot become candidate-ready.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only prior-race history through 2026-08-07 that was available before the target cutoff may enter runner features.
chronological_fold_design.input_clock: HTM, DU, and DR hashes and observed modification times are fixed before candidate construction; DR data category must be the pre-race entry category and its post time must match the pre-registered schedule.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair polling; quote source, receipt, and selected-asof times must all be at or before strict T-3.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real 2026-08-08 inference, quote, outcome, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: A uniquely identified schedule version received before decision is locked before quote access; no actual post time is used retrospectively.

hypothesis: A successor config that binds experiment_id EXP-20260808-019 and resolves every frozen model/history path to the existing UTF-8 project root is sufficient for the unchanged approved Grade-R candidate pipeline to execute.

During APPROVED_TO_PREPARE, create one successor config with experiment_id EXP-20260808-019 and exact existing UTF-8 project paths

Retain all 36 fixed races in the denominator and reject every expired or unsupported race
Use only the frozen non-odds M1C candidate policy, calibrator, confidence threshold, and tie-break
lineage_hash_requirements: Every Top3-set and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks

Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, candidate_changed_after_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero

The source HTM, DU, DR, three target manifests, fold manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and prior-history inputs remain hash-bound
The successor config experiment_id exactly equals EXP-20260808-019
null_hypothesis: The corrected successor config remains insufficient, any runtime/model/policy change is required, or no still-on-time flat target can be frozen under the original cutoffs.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote
Any candidate reconstruction after its original cutoff or retrospective prospective promotion

Any support for obstacle races or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt

primary_metric.baseline: EXP018 passed 82 tests and both human approvals, then failed before candidate inference because its config experiment_id did not match the RUNNING lifecycle; the inherited project paths also require exact UTF-8 binding.
primary_metric.evaluation: Successor config identity and every static model/history path pass preflight, then the unchanged command represents all 36 fixed targets while accepting only still-on-time flat races.
primary_metric.name: all_target_candidate_and_terminal_contract_completeness

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No race result dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff or strict-T3 cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.price_scope: After candidate freeze, price may only select the pre-registered shadow-ready versus no-bet action for that same pair.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 race identities and 462 input runners are fixed independently of market and results.

racing_mechanism: This successor changes no racing logic. It binds lifecycle identity to the run and replaces corrupted path text with exact existing filesystem paths for the already-frozen model and history artifacts.
